plan.subject: Atrial fibrillation treatment

allocation.reason: core clinical strategy, steady flow of new AAD studies and combination approaches
most prolific technical/outcomes area in AFib, many new techniques and trial results weekly
high-volume area with constant DOAC studies, bleeding risk assessments, and reversal agents
settled debate with EAST-AFNET 4, few truly new comparison studies
active device area with new trial data and real-world registry updates
broadly covered by anticoagulation and LAA occlusion angles, few unique new strategies
foundational for clinical practice, but many RCTs captured in other angles; guideline updates are sparse
steady but modest volume on wearables/screening, often overlaps with detection tech not pure treatment

queries.query: "rhythm control" AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib) AND ("antiarrhythmic drug" OR AAD)
queries.rationale: Tight phrase anchor for the core strategy combining rhythm control with pharmacological agents.

queries.query: (amiodarone OR flecainide OR propafenone OR dronedarone OR sotalol OR dofetilide) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AF) AND (maintenance OR "sinus rhythm")
queries.rationale: Loose synonym fallback capturing specific AADs in the context of maintaining sinus rhythm for AFib.
The canonical, precise phrase anchor for the entire intervention area.

queries.query: ("pulmonary vein isolation" OR PVI OR "cryoballoon ablation" OR "radiofrequency ablation") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AF)
queries.rationale: Broad OR group of the primary technique synonyms used in AFib ablation.

queries.query: ("pulsed field ablation" OR PFA OR "far-field ablation" OR "electroporation") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Sub-axis focusing on the newest, most discussed energy modality for ablation.

queries.query: ("recurrence" OR "success rate" OR "durable PVI" OR "blanking period") AND ("catheter ablation" OR "pulmonary vein isolation") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AF)
queries.rationale: Sub-axis focusing on outcome measures and durability of the ablation procedure.

queries.query: (DOAC OR "direct oral anticoagulant" OR "novel oral anticoagulant") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Tight phrase anchor for the modern first-line anticoagulant class in AFib.

queries.query: (apixaban OR rivaroxaban OR dabigatran OR edoxaban OR warfarin) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AF) AND (anticoagulation OR "stroke prevention")
queries.rationale: Loose synonym fallback listing all specific agent names in the context of AFib stroke prevention.

queries.query: ("bleeding risk" OR "major bleeding" OR "intracranial hemorrhage" OR HAS-BLED) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib) AND (anticoagulation OR DOAC)
queries.rationale: Sub-axis focusing on the major safety concern and risk assessment for anticoagulation.

queries.query: ("rate control" AND "rhythm control") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Tight phrase anchor for the direct comparison of the two fundamental management strategies.

queries.query: "left atrial appendage closure" AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Precise phrase anchor for the device-based stroke prevention procedure.

queries.query: ("Watchman" OR "Amplatzer Amulet" OR LAAO) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AF)
queries.rationale: Loose synonym fallback capturing the major device names and the common acronym.
Broad but necessary anchor for the overarching goal, ensuring capture of papers framing treatment around this endpoint.

queries.angle: randomized clinical trials and guideline updates
queries.query: ("randomized trial" OR RCT OR "clinical trial") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Tight anchor for the highest level of evidence, scoped to AFib.

queries.angle: randomized clinical trials and guideline updates
queries.query: ("guideline" OR "consensus statement" OR "practice advisory") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AF)
queries.rationale: Sub-axis specifically targeting synthesis documents and practice recommendations.

queries.query: ("AFib screening" OR "AF detection" OR "wearable" OR "smartwatch") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AF)
queries.rationale: OR group of key terms for the identification and monitoring aspect of AFib management.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan prioritizes high-volume, clinically actionable areas (ablation, anticoagulation) with multiple complementary queries, while giving minimum allocation to settled (rate vs rhythm) or broadly-covered (stroke prevention) angles. Total queries = 16, respecting all constraints.
